passed: Undo works with a full 15-entry app zone-undo stack and restores its own snapshot even though depth stays 15.
Undo restores zone identity/order, selected-zone identity, region mask and spatial mask.
Later unrelated zone additions and layer visibility edits survive selective Undo.
Redo refuses a subsequent zone edit because the zone signature guard changes.
Two sequential AI snapshots undo in LIFO order.
Current AI edit_layer metadata operation (visibility/opacity) is undone through the exact snapshot and its app stack entries are dropped.

findings.proof: AI changes zone color blue→red and seals after-state; a later manual finish edit is made on that same zone; doUndo restores the whole before-zone, reverting color and also erasing the later manual finish.
findings.source: undoApply selective zone branch; undoRestore compares zoneSig and replaces changed touched zone with undoZoneFrom(snapshot).
findings.result: Undo is not conflict-aware at field granularity and does not refuse.

findings.area: source/document identity for Undo and Redo
findings.proof: Source identity is changed while the zone object/ID remains; doUndo still restores the earlier zone snapshot into the current source. redoLast also succeeds after source-only identity change when zone/layer signatures are unchanged.
findings.source: undoSnapTake stores zones/selection/layer metadata only; redoGuard is undoSigNow() (zones and layer presentation); doUndo/redoLast contain no source identity check.
findings.result: Must be guarded by parent integration before promotion.

findings.severity: conditional limitation, not confirmed current route defect
findings.proof: A mocked pixel-buffer edit remains changed after exact snapshot Undo; undoDropPushed removes the layer undo record and doUndo skips legacy undoLayerEdit when undoRestore returns true. However frozen applyLayerOps only calls visibility/opacity/blend setters; no direct layer.data/pixel mutation was found in this source, and the public edit_layer tool exposes those metadata fields only.
findings.source: applyLayerOps lines around 520-535; layerState snapshots only id/visible/opacity/blend; undoApply restores only those values.
findings.result: Current supported metadata edits pass. If any queue path adds layer-pixel mutation, snapshot must include pixel inverse or explicitly use a matching layer inverse; test case is marked counterfactual.

limits: The harness evaluates actual extracted undo helpers, doUndo, redoLast and applyLayerOps with deterministic mocked app effects; it does not boot the whole application or execute the complete production applyQueue pipeline.
The source-switch case uses a test identity marker because source identity is not captured or read by these undo functions; a native source reload and same-zone continuity were not exercised.
The raw layer pixel mutation is counterfactual; no current pixel-writing edit_layer/applyLayerOps route was found in the frozen source.
No live source, W10 candidate, Wiki, mirror, provider, browser, native app or server was modified or invoked.
